warnings: Floor-2 beam plan. No grid bubbles on S-04; positions from the printed chains (1.50 | 4.00 x16 | 1.50 along x; 1.50 | 2.50 | 5.50 | 2.50 | 1.50 along y; 4.00 | 1.50 below the stair halls) named with the A-09 bubbles.

Cantilever corridors/sunshades: R6 cantilevers 1.50 at every grid on row A and at grids 2, 3, 6-12, 15, 16 on row D (R4 at grids 1/17), tipped by edge beams R5 on A'''' / D'' (A'''' named A'' before the 2026-10-23 gridfix re-sequencing); end bays carry R3/R4 cantilevers with edge beams R1, R1/1 and corner pieces R5/1.

Label ambiguity, decided: on the left stair hall the C-D labels 'B4' are printed next to grids 3 and 4, while the right stair hall prints 'B4' next to both hall lines 13 and 14 and floors 3-4 label both hall lines 4/5 (B11). Grid 5 C-D carries no label at all. Taken: grid 4 B4 (printed), grid 5 B4 (inferred by symmetry, flagged), and grid 3 recorded as printed — B10 A-C + B4 C-D although there is no column at C3 (flagged). The alternative reading (the grid-3 label belongs to grid 5, grid 3 is one B10 A-D like grid 15) is genuinely plausible; both affected entries carry confidence 0.6.
Split at supports only: B10 on grids 6-12/15 and B14 on grids 2/16 are one segment A-D (no column at B or C); B12 on grids 1/17 runs A-C (column C4 at C).

Stair halls 4-5 and 13-14: B6 on rows A, C, D; B3 on row B and B3 at B'''' (5.45 from A per S-14's 2.55 from row C) bearing on B7; B8 A-B, B7 B-C, B4 C-D on both hall lines; the hall projects beyond D as a canopy: B9 D-E to the C5 columns, B9/1 E-E', B13 on D'', R16 on E with R16/1 stubs, R5 / R5/1 on E', R1 / R1/1 along the canopy edges. The canopy edge lines (10.60/17.40/46.60/53.40) are not dimensioned along x and are scaled (~1.40 outside the hall lines).
Corner pipe boxes at A1/A17: two Bx each (top on the column face line, bottom 1.10 below it); the outer side is drawn dashed (no By on this floor).
Slab marks (RS1-RS4, S1, S2, S3, S3/1, S5, HC, 'บันได 1') are in _view1_etc_plan_slab.json. The '300 kg/m2' boxes are the HC design live load (same note as S-03).
